description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

MANTECH is a defense technology company delivering cybersecurity, IT, and data analytics solutions for the Department of Defense. The Software Developer will contribute across the software development life cycle to design, develop, integrate, test, and maintain Navy combat identification systems and IFF interfaces.
Software developer building, integrating, testing, and maintaining Navy combat-system identification software

Responsibilities:
• Conducting innovative software development solutions for various Navy identification systems
• Executing scientific, engineering, and technical services required for the design, development, integration, and testing of combat systems
• Analyzing technology and capability gaps to research, develop, and deploy software solutions
• Collaborating with other developers and project leads to design, optimize, and define associated deliverables
• Conducting integration, testing, bug fixes, and other software maintenance activities
• Assisting in the creation of technical documentation and user guides in support of developed software

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
• 1+ years of experience in software development
• Experience programming in Linux
• Experience with C/C++
• Must be a US Citizen and possess a current or active Secret Security Clearance

Preferred:
• Experience using Wireshark and Eclipse IDE for development
• Experience using SVN for source code configuration management
